data.title: MQDC Launches Mulberry Grove The Forestias, a Super Luxury Multi-Generational Condo
data.description: Magnolia Quality Development Corporation Limited (MQDC) has launched Mulberry Grove The Forestias Condominiums, a super luxury low-rise condominium development spanning over 16 rai within The Forestias. Construction is now complete, and the project is ready for occupancy. The development stands out for its expansive surrounding greenery and design approach that seamlessly integrates nature with urban living, under the concept of Nurturing Multi-Generational Living — creating a residence where every member of the family, across every generation, can live and thrive together.
